TOWN OF ALPINE — SAMPLE TOWN COUNCIL AGENDA (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

This is a synthetic, sanitized fixture used only by the Stage 1 Slice 1
integration smoke (GOV-77). It is NOT real crawled raw data and intentionally
contains no real names, addresses, or other personal data. Its byte content is
fixed so its SHA-256 is stable across runs; the smoke re-hashes it to prove the
raw-preservation / reproducibility invariant (contract 1.04).
